experiment.name: cholesky-stress-2048-avx2-native
experiment.description: Order-2048 Cholesky stress and scaling study with unblocked order-32 controls: numerical/ownership preflight, then allocating and workspace factors, solves and GP evaluations. Seed 139, noise 1e-6, jitter 1e-10; fitting rounds stay at order 512. Not a before/after comparison. x86_64 AVX2 pool without AVX-512. Prepared Linux x64 release harness, two process repetitions, per-process backend/library receipts.
